body.name: finite-precision rational input model
body.construction: \(\widetilde{\mathcal D}_{n,b}=((X_i,A_i,\mathcal Y_{i,b})_{i=1}^n;\text{ outward dyadic enclosures of }\epsilon,M,\alpha\text{ of diameter at most }2^{-b};\delta_{\mathrm{num}})\), where the categorical and treatment coordinates are exact, \(Y_i\in\mathcal Y_{i,b}\), \(\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal Y_{i,b})\le2^{-b}M\), and \(\mathsf L_{\mathrm{in}}\) is the total binary length of this finite string.
